area: WhatsApp solution providers overview
facts: Partner types: Solution Partners, Tech Providers, Tech Partners.
Solution Partners can extend a credit line; becoming one is lengthy; Tech Providers have Direct Support.
Providers use business tokens exclusively.

area: Become a Tech Provider
facts: Requires business verification and Advanced access through App Review.
Independent Tech Provider or via a Solution Partner (only Solution Partner app ids are accepted).

area: Embedded Signup overview and onboarding as a Tech Provider
facts: Embedded Signup v2 was deprecated on 2026-10-15; v4 is required.
Tech Provider customers must attach a payment method to their WABA unless a Solution Partner shares credit.
A sandbox test account can simulate a customer completing the flow.

area: App Review and permissions (WhatsApp)
facts: Business apps are auto-approved for Standard Access.
A direct developer using only its own business assets needs neither Advanced access nor App Review.
whatsapp_business_manage_events logs events such as purchase and leads; auto-approved if Advanced access to whatsapp_business_messaging exists.

area: Conversions API for Business Messaging (newer version)
facts: Graph v26.0 samples; ctwa_clid is a personal identifier, unique per click, stored with the conversation.
Fourteen supported event names; Meta does not deduplicate; the 7-day limit and subset-of-countries limit apply to the hashed fallback only.
note: Fetched with a redirect; this is the version to cite.

area: Conversions API for Business Messaging (older snapshot)
facts: Graph v16.0 samples; partner-addressed; Ads Management Standard Access prerequisite (1,500 calls in 15 days).
Same event list and the same deduplication note.
note: Served at the old URL; differs from D05. Always record the final URL.

area: Webhooks: create endpoint and overview
facts: GET handshake returns 200 with hub.challenge; POST carries X-Hub-Signature-256.
Non-200 deliveries retried with decreasing frequency for up to 7 days; payloads up to 3 MB; one endpoint per Meta app; mTLS supported.

area: Cloud API get started
facts: Setup creates a test WABA and a test business number that can message up to 5 verified recipients.

area: WhatsApp Business Solution Terms (preview URL)
facts: No use of Business Solution Data, including derived forms, to train or improve AI models, except fine-tuning a model for exclusive use.
No sharing with third parties except Third Party Service Providers; no building or augmenting profiles on individual users except message-thread content.
note: Preview URL; the AI Providers clause was not on the retrieved page and is SUPPORTED by quotation only.

facts: Policy page is dated 2026-09-23; messaging compliance, referenced policies and enforcement apply to WhatsApp Business services.

facts: Primary responder managed through Business Agent Platform APIs; can call our APIs and subscribe to webhooks.

area: Current WhatsApp Terms for the Business Platform
facts: Official English terms state an effective date of 2026-09-23 and incorporate both the WhatsApp Business Messaging Policy and separate Meta Terms for WhatsApp Business Platform.
The terms describe WhatsApp's own global processing/transfer of Platform Services data and place legal compliance, required notices and opt-outs on the business.
note: This is the current Platform Terms document, not the separate incorporated Meta Terms. The platform's own data practices do not itself decide our separate legal basis to transfer customer data.

area: Algeria WhatsApp Business API message rates (secondary)
facts: Reports Algeria (+213) is billed under Rest of Africa from 2026-10-01: USD 0.0225 per delivered marketing message and USD 0.0040 per utility, authentication or service message.
Reports 1,000 free service messages per business phone number per month and an eligible free Click-to-WhatsApp entry-point window up to 7 days.
note: Secondary rate aggregation, not an official invoice or direct successful retrieval of Meta's rate-card page. Provider surcharges and the account billing currency are separate.
